error.SESSION_BUSY: Session is busy; try again later
linkage.active_note: Running sessions keep their runtime; scripts, memory and Skills are not recreated.
linkage.background_note: Saved role choice → resolved model, not all background work
linkage.confirm_apply: Apply these changes to Crew defaults? New sessions only.

linkage.mate2_unsupported: Crew 0.11 Mate 2.0 owns per-Mate Agent Profiles and separate Conductor/Worker sessions. This legacy default does not establish each Mate’s running backend. Linkage writes are disabled here until the host contract is verified; use native Crew Settings.

linkage.override_warning: Setting was written, but a higher-priority Crew override may still apply. Check Crew settings.
linkage.pin_requires_byo: Select BYO as the main backend to pin a BYO model; old pins may be cleared.
linkage.schedules_note: Cron uses job type, session and explicit overrides; actual runtime is not inferred

linkage.switch_note: This changes only Crew’s two default ACP settings after confirmation. It does not install an automatic follow policy.
linkage.title: Unified backend linkage
linkage.unavailable: Crew backend state is unavailable; no synchronization will run.
linkage.warn_cron_model_conflicts: Some Agent Cron model pins may be incompatible. No jobs are rewritten.
linkage.warn_one_time_only: This is one-time synchronization; later changes in Crew will not be watched.
linkage.warn_role_model_conflicts: Some pinned background/subagent models may be incompatible. No role models are rewritten.
linkage.warn_sessions_unchanged: Existing sessions and explicit overrides stay untouched.
mode.dyna.description: Dyna is a fully capable mode that assigns models, workers and reviews to match each task. Miracle specializes in dynamic teamwork, Flash balances execution, and Strong focuses on difficult work.
mode.dyna.miracle.short: Specialist matching · Dynamic delegation · Bounded teamwork
mode.dyna.strong.short: Deep problem-solving · Quality first · Independent review
mode.tiga.description: Tiga is Kiro BYO’s general-purpose intelligent routing Mode. It chooses execution strategies dynamically using task needs, model capabilities and runtime feedback to balance efficiency and reliability.
mode.tiga.multi.short: Default · Auto · Selects from all models per task
records.all_scope: Only recent requests are summarized here. Route events and recovery runs have separate ledgers and are retained when requests are cleared.
records.cancel_origin_client_detail: The ACP client sent session/cancel (not necessarily a manual action).
records.cancel_origin_unrecorded: Not recorded (inspect the raw event trace).
records.center.limited: Only the most recent events are shown. Use a category to inspect older entries.
records.center.retained_scope: Counts reflect retained records, not lifetime totals. Ledgers have separate cleanup rules; active runs and uncertain side effects remain protected.
records.center.run_page_limit: Protected run count covers only the most recent 500 loaded runs.
records.center.subtitle: Explore requests, routing, runtime events and recovery
records.center.timeline_help: Recent turns, routing decisions, runtime events and recoveries are linked where identifiers exist. Ledgers remain independent.
records.center.title: Records center
records.trace_disabled: Runtime Trace is off, so routing events are unavailable. Check KIRO_BYO_RUNTIME_TRACE.
settings.error_navigation: Navigate away and back to try again.
settings.response_language_help: Auto follows the current user message, then recent conversation; if ambiguous, it may use the selected UI language. Explicit requests take priority.
settings.ui_language_help: Controls the BYO UI. When neither the message nor recent conversation identifies a language, it also supplies a fallback for automatic replies and visible reasoning.
settings.visible_reasoning_help: Best-effort request to the provider; hidden reasoning is not modified and providers may ignore it.
task_console.actual_not_config: A route target is not a confirmed provider completion
task_console.background_help: Auto remains a saved policy; resolved routes do not replace the setting
task_console.footer: Crew owns configuration; BYO telemetry is execution evidence, not official credit billing
task_console.no_recent: No recorded BYO background executions yet
task_console.recent_help: Only explicitly recorded BYO background Auto turns, not guessed cron/official executions
task_console.schedules_help: Uses native Crew cron jobs; only Agent jobs have AI model overrides
task_console.selection_not_execution: Not evidence that a request succeeded
task_console.subtitle: Manage native Crew schedules and background AI models with execution evidence
